newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Lernout & Hauspie in Pacific Rim deal.
newsitem.headline: Lernout & Hauspie in Pacific Rim deal.

text.p: IEPER, Belgium, June 13 - Lernout & Hauspie Speech Products (L&H) said that it significantly increased its presence in the Pacific Rim area by signing a licence agreement with Bumil Information & Communications Co. Ltd. of Korea.
L&H said the agreement under which Bumil will use its speech technology in forthcoming products could mean several million dollars of revenue over the coming years.
Bumil develops service bureau software, commonly used to provide up-to-date information via telephone on topics as diverse as sports scores and stock prices.
Bumil operates its own service bureau in Korea with more than 2,400 telephone lines and resells its service bureau software to developers.
Under the terms of the agreement, Bumil will distribute L&H's text-to-speech (TTS) and automatic speech recognition (ASR) technology in the Korean telecommunications market.
Bumil will incorporate L&H's host-based TTS technology into its service bureau applications immediately and onto Dialogic Antares boards for availability in the second quarter of 1997.
In addition, L&H and Bumil will jointly develop ASR technology for specific Korean service bureau applications that will be available in the second half of this year.
